text:
For the choir director. With flutes. A psalm of David.[^1]

[^1]: The Hebrew term rendered "flutes" is uncertain; it may name a melody or a type of instrument.

versions.text: For the choir director. With flutes. A psalm of David.
versions.explanation: The meaning of נְחִילוֹת is genuinely uncertain. A brief footnote would help the reader without disturbing the reading flow of the line.

text: Listen to my words, LORD; understand my sighing.
Pay attention to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
LORD, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my plea before you and watch for your answer.

versions.text: LORD, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my case before you and wait.
versions.explanation: אֲצַפֶּה means to watch or look out expectantly (as a lookout), which is stronger than plain "wait"; the added nuance also improves the closing rhythm of the line.

text: For you are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil cannot dwell with you.
The arrogant cannot stand before your eyes; you hate all who do wrong.
You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD detests the violent and the deceitful.
But I, through your abundant mercy, will enter your house; in reverence for you I will bow toward your holy temple.
LORD, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before me.
For there is nothing trustworthy in their mouth; within them is destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they flatter.

versions.text: For there is nothing trustworthy in their mouth; within them is destruction. Their throat is an open grave; their tongue is smooth flattery.
versions.explanation: יַחֲלִיקוּן is a verb ("they make smooth, they flatter"), so a verbal rendering is closer to the Hebrew and reads more naturally aloud than the noun phrase "smooth flattery."

text: Declare them guilty, God! Let them fall by their own schemes. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
But let all who take refuge in you rejoice; let them sing for joy forever. Spread your shelter over them, and let those who love your name exult in you.
For you, LORD, bless the righteous; you surround them with favor as with a shield.
